phases.title: PH-005 reconciliation and PH-002 inventory freeze
phases.goal: stale workflow projection을 정합화하고 PH-002 전체 입력을 immutable baseline으로 동결한다.

phases.title: Fair-delivery baseline provenance
phases.goal: 행동 변경 없이 동결한 source/test/artifact/raw-evidence 전체 inventory의 pre/post 일치를 검증한다.

phases.title: AC admission characterization
phases.goal: 기존 command와 artifact를 다시 실행해 AC 증거와 gap을 분리한다.

phases.title: Independent admission review
phases.goal: fail-closed 조건, TODO 경계, rollback과 evidence를 독립 검토한다.

phases.title: Conditional close or corrective handoff
phases.goal: evidence 충족 시에만 guarded sync를 수행하고, 아니면 true-TDD corrective scope를 만든다.

tasks.title: Reconcile the stale PH-005 projection and freeze the PH-002 inventory
tasks.action: Reconcile the PH-005 projection and freeze the complete PH-002 scheduler/policy/restore, benchmark, browser ACK/unit/E2E, decision/publication inventory with Git state and SHA-256; record the decision artifact raw-evidence root with the declared canonical tree path, count, and digest before replay.

items: MIG AC-1..AC-6 evidence is rechecked
workflow discrepancy is observable
the complete PH-002 inventory and canonical raw-evidence tree baseline are recorded
no speculative SRS mutation

dod: PH-005 projection is reconciled or its exact workflow blocker is recorded.
PH-002 whole inventory and canonical raw-evidence tree are frozen before replay.
Existing MIG status and AC are not changed by inference.
tasks.rollback: If guarded workflow mutation fails, preserve the current projection and record the diagnostic only.

tasks.title: Freeze external fair-delivery baseline provenance
tasks.action: Compare the complete PH-001 immutable inventory before and after replay, including Git state, SHA-256, and the canonical raw-evidence tree; only an exact whole-inventory match may be recorded as external provenance.

items: pre/post Git state and SHA-256 cover every frozen PH-002 input
the canonical raw-evidence tree path, count, and digest match
any mismatch rejects admission
fail-closed and evidence-gap boundaries are explicit

dod: external-baseline-manifest.json records the complete pre/post inventory, input/raw-evidence hashes, canonical tree digest, publication pointer and gap classification.
Any whole-inventory mismatch rejects admission and triggers recharacterization.
No production or test behavior is changed.
tasks.rollback: Remove only the generated manifest; leave fair-delivery code and legacy fallback untouched.

tasks.title: Replay server fairness, ledger, and fallback evidence
tasks.action: AC-1..AC-8 lane ordering, encoded-byte metric, artifact provenance, policy, ACK error, bounded fallback, cleanup와 epoch evidence를 replay하고 docs/analysis/kiwi-coder-2026-07-16.projectmaster.wave3-authority-fairness/ph-006/external-baseline-ac-matrix.json 및 external-baseline-replay-report.md에 verdict and hashes를 기록한다; split TODO 의존 claim은 unsatisfied로 분류한다.

acceptance_tests.threshold: published artifact thresholds, tolerances, raw trial and starvation gate

dod: external-baseline-ac-matrix.json and external-baseline-replay-report.md record every AC-1..AC-8 verdict, evidence path and input/raw-evidence hash or explicit gap.
tasks.rollback: Keep candidate admission closed and retain legacy safe-send.

tdd.exempt_reason: This task only characterizes an external shared-worktree baseline and makes no production or test behavior change.

tasks.title: Replay browser ACK and idle-invariant boundary evidence
tasks.action: Accepted-write ACK, AI TUI idle invariant, hidden recovery false capability와 injected E2E boundary를 replay하고 docs/analysis/kiwi-coder-2026-07-16.projectmaster.wave3-authority-fairness/ph-006/external-baseline-ac-matrix.json 및 external-baseline-replay-report.md의 AC-9 row에 결과를 기록한다; normal browser activation 또는 PH-007 behavior claim을 거부한다.

items: Normal browser capability remains false
ACK and idle evidence are separate
hidden recovery or split TODO dependencies are explicit

verification_cmd.posix: pnpm exec vitest run tests/unit/terminalContainerRecoveryContract.test.ts && pnpm exec playwright test tests/e2e/wave3-terminal-authority-fairness.spec.ts --project "Desktop Chrome" --grep "identified-delivery ACK|idle"
verification_cmd.windows: pnpm exec vitest run tests/unit/terminalContainerRecoveryContract.test.ts; if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { exit $LASTEXITCODE }; pnpm exec playwright test tests/e2e/wave3-terminal-authority-fairness.spec.ts --project "Desktop Chrome" --grep "identified-delivery ACK|idle"

dod: external-baseline-ac-matrix.json and external-baseline-replay-report.md record the AC-9 evidence/hash or explicit gap without changing browser behavior.
tasks.rollback: No browser capability or renderer behavior is changed.

tasks.title: Review baseline provenance, gaps, and rollback gate
tasks.action: Independent review compares the provenance, AC matrix, replay report, raw evidence, policy provenance, TODO boundaries, cleanup/rollback and no-retroactive-TDD statement; only a No-findings review plus complete independent AC-1..AC-9 evidence permits add_verification_evidence, then check_acceptance_criteria, then update_status(implemented); completed-work and verified are prohibited before every prior AC evidence/check and the implemented mutation succeed; unsatisfied AC rejects admission and leaves PERF in_progress.

items: Every AC is independently evidenced, unsatisfied, or explicitly deferred
Only a No-findings review plus complete independent AC-1..AC-9 evidence permits add_verification_evidence, then check_acceptance_criteria, then update_status(implemented)
completed-work and verified are prohibited before every prior AC evidence/check and the implemented mutation succeed
No retrospective TDD or default promotion claim
Legacy rollback and fail-closed behavior are preserved

dod: Only a No-findings independent review with complete AC-1..AC-9 evidence permits the exact add_verification_evidence, check_acceptance_criteria, then update_status(implemented) lifecycle.
Reject creates a bounded true-TDD follow-up and leaves PERF in_progress without completed-work or verified promotion.
tasks.rollback: Reject leaves PERF in_progress and candidate admission closed.

tasks.title: Apply conditional evidence sync or create true-TDD corrective scope
tasks.action: Only after PH-004 No findings and complete per-AC evidence, perform guarded per-AC evidence mutation, per-AC acceptance checks, then update_status(implemented); completed-work and verified are prohibited until all prior steps succeed. Otherwise preserve in_progress without completed-work or verified mutation and create a separate strict RED-to-GREEN corrective scope.

items: Mutation is conditional on complete evidence
promotion order is per-AC evidence, per-AC acceptance check, then implemented status; completed-work and verified occur only after success
Rejection preserves in_progress, fail-closed behavior, and no completed-work or verified mutation
Corrective code work is genuine test-first

dod: Guarded lifecycle follows evidence, AC-check, implemented order with completed-work and verified deferred until success, or strict-TDD handoff is recorded.
PH-007 is not started from an unadmitted baseline.
tasks.rollback: Do not change status, AC, or completed-work when admission is rejected.

risks.description: Shared worktree change invalidates baseline provenance.
risks.mitigation: Reject admission and regenerate manifest on hash mismatch.

risks.description: Split TODO or hidden-recovery boundary could be misrepresented as green evidence.
risks.mitigation: Mark affected AC unsatisfied and keep promotion fail-closed.

risks.description: Legacy workflow schema can block PH-005 reconciliation.
risks.mitigation: Use official repair record; never hand-edit checklist state.
